text.en:
Article five hundred and ninety-one of the Penal Code is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Article 591. The penalty of arresto menor shall be imposed upon any person, who, for profit or gain, shall
interpret dreams, make forecasts, tell fortunes, or take advantage of the credulity of the public in any other
similar manner, unless the offense be punishable under Book II of this Code."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 2, 1926.
